name: changes-story social-cards-media
judge: The article as rendered shows the change with the captured product screenshots: an image whose URL ends in pricing-card (and optionally features-page) appears with a caption saying what it shows. The published before-and-after page appears as its URL alone on its own line, which is how the page renders an embedded page, after a sentence saying what it shows. No image whose URL ends in term appears. An image whose URL ends in pasted-bug appears only beside a sentence telling the problem it shows (shared links showed the home page card), or not at all.
